method: Rendered CSS token measurement with check-contrast.ts; named keyboard interactions in screenshots.ts --interactions; visual review of full-page captures and DOM row geometry via T3 preview.

contrast.meaningfulGraphics: Opaque primary, muted, success, warning, danger and info strokes/fills on neutral cards are measured supported pairs. Decorative grids/separators are not meaningful boundaries.

keyboardSpotChecks: Finance: keyboard period menu, placeholder tab and return, named transfer field, actual Tab/Shift+Tab focus outline
E-commerce: order filter, checkbox selection, sorting, pagination and action menu
Academy: focusable student achievement popup and full score labels
Logistics: keyboard shipment selection, mobile sheet Escape and focus return
Infrastructure: group collapse, named project/environment action menus
Productivity: task checkbox and arrow-key calendar selection
Analytics: range/tab selection; Analytics V1 risk filter and sort
Patient Monitoring: keyboard acknowledgement, patient selection and event/trend views; clock movement and waveform path comparison under runtime motion preference changes
visualCoverage: Default/Default V1 solid, dashed and dotted lines with matching legends
CRM/CRM V1 labelled bars, pattern segments, donut labels and funnel labels
Finance signed cash-flow bars, readable breakdowns and labelled allocation segments
Analytics/Analytics V1 line/baseline distinction, traffic bars, forecast dot/target references
Productivity numeric progress labels and calendar focus
E-commerce revenue/profit marks, traffic shares, stock gauge and payment/fulfillment badges
Academy grouped submissions with data table and performance timelines with names/scores
Logistics endpoint captions with origin circle and destination square; explicit shipment statuses
Infrastructure resource values and severity/health text
Patient Monitoring labelled ECG/Pleth/Resp/ART traces, alarm text and numeric units

layoutFinding.lowerRow: Wallet, bills and stacked quick actions now share the same bottom edge
layoutFinding.otherRoutes: All other 13 routes inspected; common comparison rows aligned. Independent sidebar work streams retain content-driven height.

limits: Scoped contrast, visual and keyboard checks; not a blanket WCAG conformance claim. Existing demo actions and external Logistics basemap retained.
